name: PFN Summer Internship
amount: ¥2,500/hour (8 h/day, 5 days/week) + one round trip and arranged accommodation for interns living outside the Kanto area
tags: Need legal right to intern in Japan

eligibility.note: Students aged 18+ with the legal right to intern/work part-time in Japan (e.g. Japanese nationality, permanent residency, or a student visa with permission for activities outside status) who count as 'residents' under Japan's Foreign Exchange Act; students living abroad without Japanese status are not eligible. Former PFN interns excluded.

fields: Machine learning, computer science, robotics, chemistry/materials and other fields PFN works on
note: Paid summer internship at PFN's Tokyo (Otemachi) office in hybrid format; in practice open to international students already studying in Japan.

name: NIMS Internship Program
host: National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS), Tsukuba
amount: Selected students: daily allowance (¥2,560/day per NIMS FAQ) + accommodation fee in NIMS-designated housing
dlText: ~end Dec 2026 (round expected to open Dec 2026 for about one month; estimated)
note: Contact a NIMS researcher (via the SAMURAI directory), who forwards your application; financial support is selective and requires staying in NIMS-designated accommodation.

name: R-CCS International HPC Computational Science Internship Program
amount: ¥3,000/day of attendance + round-trip travel + furnished apartment + commuting costs (up to ¥45,000/month)
dlText: Term 1: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 JST; Term 2: 8 Feb 2027, 12:00 JST

eligibility.note: Students enrolled at a university outside Japan, mainly doctoral students in computational science; undergraduate/master's students only if the target team accepts them. An official request letter from your institution's head is needed after selection.

note: About 30 interns a year at R-CCS teams in Kobe, Tokyo or Wako; allow ~4 months between selection and start.

name: R-IH Summer Program Internship
host: RIKEN Information R&D and Strategy Headquarters (R-IH)
amount: ¥2,400/day allowance + ¥11,600/day accommodation (90% after 30 days, 80% after 60) + round-trip travel; paid after the programme
fields: Data science, open science, networking, computational/fundamental physics data
note: Summer research internship at RIKEN Wako (and Keihanna) with daily allowance, accommodation and travel paid; you need to pay costs upfront as reimbursement comes after the programme.

name: RIKEN IMS Internship Program
host: RIKEN Center for Integrative Medical Sciences (IMS)
amount: ¥3,000/working day + lodging (up to ¥11,600/day, lower for longer stays) + travel
dlText: Apply at least 4 months before your desired start (FY2026 round closed; FY2027 dates: check official page)

eligibility.note: Master's or PhD students (or medical students at master's-equivalent level) enrolled at an academic institution during the internship; supervisor recommendation required.

fields: Immunology, genomics, medical and life sciences
note: Category 1 interns get allowance, lodging and travel; apply by email with a research proposal for a chosen IMS lab.

name: Ai2 Research and Engineering Internships
amount: Competitive pay (amount not published): check official page
dlText: Year-round; summer openings usually posted in the autumn before
fields: AI, machine learning, NLP, computer vision, software engineering
note: Research internships for undergraduate and graduate students in AI; international candidates welcome with visa sponsorship.

name: Cohere Internships (Research, ML Engineering, Software)
amount: Competitive compensation (amount not published): check official page
dlText: Posted throughout the year; summer 2027 internships open Jan 2027

eligibility.note: Enrolled undergraduate, master's or PhD students (research roles: PhD) or graduates within 6 months; you must already be authorised to work where you are hired, as Cohere offers no visa sponsorship or relocation.

fields: Machine learning research, ML engineering, software engineering
note: Paid full-time internships, remote or from a Cohere office depending on role and location.

name: MERL Research Internships
amount: Most postings $6,000–8,000/month (some $4,000–8,000) + relocation stipend + travel to/from MERL
dlText: Positions posted individually with flexible start dates through 2027

eligibility.note: Mostly current PhD students (some roles open to master's/undergraduate students); requires full US work authorisation, with MERL immigration support for qualified candidates.

fields: AI, computer vision, robotics, optimisation, signal processing, electronics
note: Around 40 intern positions listed at a time; apply to specific postings.

name: E3 – EPFL Excellence in Engineering Summer Research Program
amount: CHF 1,800/month (Lausanne, Sion, Fribourg) or CHF 2,500/month (Geneva, Neuchâtel), pro rata + travel refunded with host-lab approval
dlText: 1 Nov 2026 (time not stated); results by mid-Mar 2027
nextText: Next call expected ~Sep–Nov 2027 for summer 2028 (estimated from the 2026 cycle)
note: Summer research internship in an EPFL engineering lab for bachelor's/master's students from other institutions who plan a PhD.

name: EPFL Excellence Research Internship Program (ERIP)
dlText: 30 Nov 2026 (time not stated); reference letters by 6 Dec 2026

eligibility.note: Top-10% bachelor's/master's students (≥2 bachelor years done) at EPFL partner universities in North America and Singapore, nominated by their international office (McGill/Toronto after pre-selection).

note: Three-month lab research internship at EPFL; the scholarship covers housing and basic living costs.

name: EPFL Life Sciences Summer Research Program
amount: CHF 3,600 for 2 months (covers housing + living) + travel up to CHF 1,000 (overseas) / CHF 500 (shorter distances)
nextText: Next call expected ~autumn 2027, closing ~mid-Nov (estimated from the 2026 cycle)
note: Eight-week research programme in EPFL life-science labs open to students worldwide; PhD students are not eligible.

name: Summer Undergraduate Research (SUR) Programme
host: University of Lausanne, Faculty of Biology and Medicine
amount: ~CHF 1,500 for living costs + free accommodation + travel up to CHF 500 (Europe) / CHF 1,200 (overseas)
nextText: Next call expected ~autumn 2027, closing ~mid-Nov (estimated from the 2026 cycle)
note: Eight-week lab research programme in Lausanne; travel is reimbursed after the programme and visa fees are not covered.

name: SOKENDAI KEK Tsukuba/J-PARC Summer Student Program
host: KEK (High Energy Accelerator Research Organization) / SOKENDAI
amount: Airfare + free KEK/J-PARC dormitory + ¥1,500/day per diem + airport transfers (visa and insurance not covered)
note: Summer research stay at KEK Tsukuba or J-PARC open to students of any nationality; about 21 participants in recent years.

name: MPIIB International Summer Internship (MPIIB-ISI)
host: Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology, Berlin
amount: €1,400/month stipend + travel compensation + accommodation near the institute
dlText: 27 Nov 2026 (time not stated); internship 1 Sep–30 Nov 2027

eligibility.note: International bachelor's (≥4 semesters) and master's students enrolled throughout; aimed at students whose education is constrained by personal, financial, regional or societal issues, with applicants from low- and middle-income countries strongly encouraged.

note: Three-month autumn research internship in Berlin; visa fees are not covered.

name: Biological Physics Summer Internship (MPI-PKS)
host: Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems, Dresden
amount: Financially supported (amount not stated): check official page
note: Summer 2027 research internship in a biophysics group; dates arranged with the group leader.

name: IMPRS Physics from Light to Life Internships
host: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light / IMPRS Erlangen
nextText: Next call expected ~autumn 2027 (estimated from the 2026 cycle)
note: Research internship at MPL, MPZPM, FAU or Uniklinikum Erlangen; applicants affiliated with institutions in Russia or Iran cannot currently be considered.
